title: A ship detection network training method based on federated learning and its application method

pse.problem: The existing federal learning method is difficult to utilize training data with unbalanced distribution and uneven quality effectively, causing reduced model accuracy for ship detection networks.
pse.solution_function: The method performs iterative training of a ship detection network using local detection networks from multiple clients. It enhances the ship image data through double-branch attention enhancement and feature fusion detection. The prediction total loss is determined using a dynamic non-monotonic focusing method. Local parameters are updated based on this loss, and global parameters are obtained by self-adaptive weighted aggregation of local parameters. The local and global parameters are iteratively updated until network performance no longer improves.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a ship detection network, local detection networks from multiple clients, and data for ship images. There is also a dynamic non-monotonic focusing method used to determine the prediction total loss.
pse.solution_implementation: Each client processes their acquired ship image data through the local detection network, performing double-branch attention enhancement and feature fusion detection. The prediction total loss is determined using the dynamic non-monotonic focusing method. Local parameters are updated based on this loss, and global parameters are obtained by self-adaptive weighted aggregation of local parameters. The local parameters are then updated according to the global parameters.
pse.effect: The method can effectively utilize training data with unbalanced distribution and uneven quality, improving model accuracy for ship detection networks.
